title: Valheim Resource Reference
description: Resources grouped by natural origin for storage and gathering. Some sources and newer items require in-game verification.

implementation.summary: Create a reusable ResourceReferenceTrigger that opens a shadcn/ui Drawer from the bottom. Inside DrawerContent, render an Accordion with one section per category (General first, then biomes). Each expanded section displays a compact resource table or responsive list: resource name linking to its wiki page, source, and gathering tip. Use a scrollable content area and keep the drawer accessible on mobile. Place the trigger wherever a 'Resource Reference' link is needed.

categories.label: Found in many places
categories.storageNote: Keep wood, stone and metals near building and crafting stations; reserve separate chests by cooking and mead stations for food and ingredients.
categories.expeditionNote: Stock a departure chest with food, repaired gear, tools and portal supplies before longer trips; keep valuables and boss offerings together.

resources.name: Wood
resources.tip: Clear a stand of beech trees, collect fallen logs, and replant seeds near your base for future logging runs.

resources.name: Stone
resources.tip: Keep the stone from ore-mining trips; mine large surface boulders when you need extra building stacks.

resources.name: Finewood
resources.tip: Use a bronze axe or better on birch and oak; plant spare seeds near your base for repeat logging.

resources.name: Mushroom
resources.tip: Mark clusters in Meadows or Black Forest and revisit them on a gathering circuit after they regrow.

resources.name: Thistle
resources.tip: Mark glowing plants in Black Forest and Swamp; their blue light makes repeat runs easier at night.

resources.name: Resin
resources.tip: Fight Greydwarves around an intact Black Forest spawner and collect resin alongside eyes and stone.

resources.name: Greydwarf Eye
resources.tip: Keep a Greydwarf nest intact and collect eyes from repeated waves; bring food and repair gear.

resources.name: Bone Fragments
resources.tip: Clear skeleton-filled Burial Chambers and break bone piles; visit several chambers for larger hauls.

resources.name: Feathers
resources.tip: Shoot birds resting on shorelines during a coastal loop; check nearby chests for extra feathers.

resources.name: Coal
resources.tip: Run several charcoal kilns with spare wood, or collect coal from Surtlings around Swamp fire geysers.

resources.name: Surtling Core
resources.tip: Mark Swamp fire geysers and return for Surtling drops; early on, search multiple Burial Chambers.

resources.name: Leather Scraps
resources.tip: Tame and feed a pair of boars in a pen, then harvest offspring for repeat supplies of scraps and meat.

resources.name: Deer Hide
resources.tip: Hunt deer through open Meadows with a bow; combine hide runs with collecting deer meat.

resources.name: Deer Meat
resources.tip: Sweep open Meadows with a bow and collect hides too; use a cart or nearby chest on long hunts.

resources.name: Coins
resources.tip: Clear several dungeons and loot every chest; bring valuables to a trader to turn them into more coins.

resources.name: Amber
resources.tip: Loot chests while clearing Burial Chambers and other dungeons; save stacks to sell to a trader.

resources.name: Amber Pearl
resources.tip: Check dungeon and treasure chests during exploration, then collect several pearls for a trader trip.

resources.name: Ruby
resources.tip: Search dungeon and treasure chests as you explore; save rubies for a combined trip to the trader.

resources.name: Bukeperries
resources.tip: Fight Greydwarf groups around an intact nest to encounter shamans; collect their drops with eyes and resin.

resources.name: Yellow Mushroom
resources.tip: Mark mushroom-rich Burial Chambers or crypts and revisit them after the mushrooms regrow.

resources.name: Iron
resources.tip: Mine muddy scrap piles in several Sunken Crypts, then smelt the scrap; plan boat transport under default portal rules.

resources.name: Copper
resources.tip: Mine several Black Forest copper deposits, including the buried portions, and smelt the ore near storage.

resources.name: Honey
resources.tip: Collect queen bees from wild hives and build several happy hives outdoors; empty them regularly.

categories.label: Meadows
categories.storageNote: Keep wood, stone and hides near the workbench, and berries, meat and honey near cooking stations.
categories.expeditionNote: Prepare food, a shield and repaired gear; save two deer trophies for Eikthyr's altar.

resources.name: Raspberries
resources.tip: Mark clusters of bushes in Meadows and revisit them after berries regrow; avoid destroying the bushes.

resources.name: Dandelion
resources.tip: Gather yellow flowers while crossing open Meadows; combine runs with hunting and shoreline foraging.

resources.name: Flint
resources.tip: Walk Meadows shorelines and shallow water, collecting flint along a long stretch before returning.

resources.name: Neck Tail
resources.tip: Follow Meadows shores and hunt groups of Necks while collecting flint along the same route.

resources.name: Boar Meat
resources.tip: Tame and feed two boars in a pen; harvest offspring periodically for meat and leather scraps.

resources.name: Queen Bee
resources.tip: Search abandoned Meadows houses for buzzing hives; shoot them from a distance and gather queens for multiple hives.

resources.name: Hard Antler
resources.tip: Collect deer trophies for offerings and summon Eikthyr again at an altar when you need more antlers.

resources.name: Beech Seeds
resources.tip: Pick up seeds while cutting beech trees and replant a portion with a cultivator to maintain a wood lot.

resources.name: Birch Seeds
resources.tip: Cut birch for fine wood and gather its seeds; replant some with a cultivator for later harvests.

resources.name: Acorns
resources.tip: Gather acorns while felling oaks for fine wood; replant some with a cultivator for a future grove.

categories.label: Black Forest
categories.storageNote: Group copper, tin and coal near smelters and the forge; store seeds and berries by the kitchen and garden.
categories.expeditionNote: Bring a pickaxe and food for mining trips; save three ancient seeds and prepare upgraded gear for the Elder.

resources.name: Blueberries
resources.tip: Mark dense Black Forest berry patches and revisit them after regrowth; leave the bushes intact.

resources.name: Carrot Seeds
resources.tip: Gather wild flowers for starter seeds, then plant some harvested carrots as seed-carrots to multiply your supply.

resources.name: Carrot
resources.tip: Plant rows with a cultivator and reserve some carrots for seed-carrots so each harvest can support the next.

resources.name: Copper Ore
resources.tip: Dig around and beneath each deposit to reach buried ore; stage a cart or boat nearby for heavy loads.

resources.name: Tin Ore
resources.tip: Walk Black Forest shorelines and riverbanks, mining the small deposits along a route back to storage.

resources.name: Corewood
resources.tip: Cut Black Forest pines for core wood and plant pine cones with a cultivator for another harvest.

resources.name: Troll Hide
resources.tip: Clear trolls outside and inside caves as you explore; use a bow and room to dodge, then seek new caves.

resources.name: Bear Hide
resources.tip: Hunt rare Black Forest bears and search bear caves; collect paws and meat alongside hides.

resources.name: Bear Paw
resources.tip: Hunt Black Forest bears and search bear caves; collect paws alongside their hides and meat.

resources.name: Bear Meat
resources.tip: Hunt Black Forest bears and search bear caves; gather meat alongside hides and paws.

resources.name: Ectoplasm
resources.tip: Search multiple Burial Chambers for ghosts; chamber spawns are finite, so raids can provide additional opportunities.

resources.name: Pine Cone
resources.tip: Pick up pine cones while logging pines and reserve some for a planted core-wood grove.

resources.name: Fir Cone
resources.tip: Collect fir cones when cutting firs, then replant a portion to keep a renewable source of wood.

categories.label: Swamp
categories.storageNote: Keep scrap iron and coal near smelters, and bloodbags, entrails and turnips near food and mead stations.
categories.expeditionNote: Bring poison resistance, food and a Swamp Key for crypts; save ten withered bones for Bonemass.

resources.name: Scrap Iron
resources.tip: Bring a Swamp Key and mine muddy piles throughout several Sunken Crypts; use a boat to move large loads under default rules.

resources.name: Ancient Bark
resources.tip: Use a bronze axe or better to clear ancient trees; bring a cart or build storage nearby for larger hauls.

resources.name: Turnip Seeds
resources.tip: Find yellow seed flowers in the Swamp; grow turnips and replant some as seed-turnips to expand your crop.

resources.name: Turnip
resources.tip: Plant rows with a cultivator and reserve part of each harvest for seed-turnips.

resources.name: Bloodbag
resources.tip: Patrol shallow Swamp waterways and shoot leeches from the bank; pick up bloodbags when the water is safe.

resources.name: Entrails
resources.tip: Fight Draugr around an intact body pile for repeated drops; use poison protection and keep an escape route.

resources.name: Ooze
resources.tip: Collect drops from blobs and oozers while clearing Swamp routes; poison resistance helps on longer runs.

resources.name: Guck
resources.tip: Build stairs or platforms beside gucksacks high on trees, then break the sacks and collect the drops.

resources.name: Chain
resources.tip: Hunt Wraiths in the Swamp at night and check Sunken Crypt chests while mining scrap.

resources.name: Root
resources.tip: Hunt Abominations across several Swamp areas; fight on solid ground and bring an axe and fire damage.

resources.name: Withered Bone
resources.tip: Mine muddy scrap piles and search chests in multiple Sunken Crypts; store bones together for boss summons.

categories.label: Mountain
categories.storageNote: Store silver near the smelter and forge; keep wolf drops, obsidian and cave materials near equipment crafting.
categories.expeditionNote: Pack frost protection and a Wishbone for silver; plan transport for three heavy dragon eggs to Moder's altar.

resources.name: Silver Ore
resources.tip: Use a Wishbone to locate buried veins, then mine them fully; plan a downhill cart route or boat pickup.

resources.name: Obsidian
resources.tip: Bring an iron pickaxe or better and sweep Mountain slopes for dark surface deposits; mark a return route.

resources.name: Crystal
resources.tip: Hunt Stone Golems while exploring Mountains; use a pickaxe and solid footing, then collect crystals with other mountain resources.

resources.name: Wolf Pelt
resources.tip: Hunt Mountain wolves, or tame and feed a pair to breed a renewable supply of pelts and meat.

resources.name: Wolf Fang
resources.tip: Collect fangs alongside pelts on Mountain wolf hunts; breeding tamed wolves can provide repeat drops.

resources.name: Wolf Meat
resources.tip: Tame and feed two wolves in a secure pen, then harvest offspring for repeat meat and pelt supplies.

resources.name: Freeze Gland
resources.tip: Shoot Drakes on Mountain expeditions; check nests and peaks while collecting silver and obsidian.

resources.name: Onion Seeds
resources.tip: Search chests in Mountain ruins for starter seeds; grow onions and replant some as seed-onions to multiply them.

resources.name: Onion
resources.tip: Plant onions in rows and reserve part of each harvest for seed-onions to keep the farm going.

resources.name: Fenris Hair
resources.tip: Search walls and rooms throughout several Frost Caves; gather other cave materials in the same trip.

resources.name: Fenris Claw
resources.tip: Search Frost Cave rooms and altars thoroughly; visit more caves when you need additional claws.

resources.name: Red Jute
resources.tip: Break red curtains and other red fabric in Frost Caves; clear several caves for a larger supply.

resources.name: Dragon Egg
resources.tip: Mark Mountain nests and revisit them after eggs respawn; eggs are very heavy, so plan transport.

categories.label: Plains
categories.storageNote: Keep barley, flax and their processed products near farming and crafting stations; store black metal scrap near the blast furnace.
categories.expeditionNote: Bring strong food and repaired gear; collect five Fuling totems and prepare fire resistance for Yagluth.

resources.name: Cloudberries
resources.tip: Mark clusters across open Plains and return after the berries regrow; avoid destroying the bushes.

resources.name: Barley
resources.tip: Take starter barley from Fuling villages and plant it in a protected Plains field; save some of each harvest for replanting.

resources.name: Flax
resources.tip: Collect starter flax from Fuling villages and grow it in a protected Plains field; reserve part of each crop for replanting.

resources.name: Black Metal Scrap
resources.tip: Clear Fuling villages and patrols, then haul scrap to a blast furnace; use a boat under default portal rules.

resources.name: Lox Pelt
resources.tip: Hunt Plains herds or tame and feed two Lox in a strong enclosure for renewable pelts and meat.

resources.name: Lox Meat
resources.tip: Tame and feed a pair of Lox in a secure enclosure; harvest offspring for repeat meat and pelt supplies.

resources.name: Needle
resources.tip: Watch for Deathsquitos while crossing the Plains; block or shoot them and collect needles along your route.

resources.name: Tar
resources.tip: Clear Growths first, then dig a trench to drain the pit and retrieve tar deposits from the exposed bottom.

resources.name: Vile Ribcage
resources.tip: Hunt Viles in the Plains at night; they are very rare, so expect a long search for multiple ribcages.

resources.name: Fuling Totem
resources.tip: Search Fuling village structures and clear defenders; mark villages and visit several for more totems.

categories.label: Mistlands
categories.storageNote: Group sap and soft tissue near the eitr refinery, and mushrooms and meat near food stations; keep cores and carapace with equipment materials.
categories.expeditionNote: Bring a wisplight, food and poison protection; gather Sealbreaker fragments from Infested Mines to enter the Queen's citadel.

resources.name: Jotun Puffs
resources.tip: Collect wild Jotun Puffs, then replant some in a protected Mistlands plot for repeated harvests.

resources.name: Magecap
resources.tip: Collect wild Magecaps and replant some in a protected Mistlands plot to expand your harvests.

resources.name: Yggdrasil Wood
resources.tip: Use a black metal axe or better on Yggdrasil shoots; clear a cluster and carry wood back to nearby storage.

resources.name: Black Marble
resources.tip: Mine giant remains with a black metal pickaxe; dismantling Dvergr structures also yields marble but can provoke them.

resources.name: Soft Tissue
resources.tip: Break into giant skulls and mine the soft tissue inside; mark skulls while exploring for a dedicated collection trip.

resources.name: Sap
resources.tip: Place extractors on Ancient Roots and collect them regularly; use multiple roots and allow depleted roots time to replenish.

resources.name: Carapace
resources.tip: Clear Seekers in Infested Mines and patrol Mistlands terrain; gather meat and other drops on the same runs.

resources.name: Mandible
resources.tip: Hunt Seeker Soldiers in Mistlands and Infested Mines; aim for the less-armored rear when it is safe.

resources.name: Seeker Meat
resources.tip: Gather meat from Seekers while clearing Infested Mines or exploring Mistlands; collect carapace on the same trip.

resources.name: Hare Meat
resources.tip: Use a bow against hares in Mistlands and pick up scale hide too; listen and watch for movement in the mist.

resources.name: Scale Hide
resources.tip: Hunt hares with a bow while traveling between Mistlands objectives; collect their meat as well.

resources.name: Blood Clot
resources.tip: Clear ticks in Infested Mines and during Gjall encounters; collect clots while gathering other Mistlands drops.

resources.name: Bilebag
resources.tip: Shoot a Gjall's underside from a safe position and collect bilebags after it falls; watch for ticks and fire.

resources.name: Royal Jelly
resources.tip: Collect jelly piles in Infested Mines and mark rich rooms for later visits; Seeker Brood also drop jelly.

resources.name: Black Core
resources.tip: Search Infested Mines thoroughly, including hidden rooms; visit additional mines rather than expecting cores to respawn.

resources.name: Blue Jute
resources.tip: Search Dvergr structures for blue fabric and salvage it carefully; damaging their property can provoke nearby Dvergr.

resources.name: Dvergr Extractor
resources.tip: Look for component crates in Dvergr outposts; breaking their property can provoke them, so plan an escape.

categories.label: Ashlands
categories.storageNote: Store flametal ore and coal by the blast furnace; keep gems and creature drops near equipment stations and food plants by the kitchen.
categories.expeditionNote: Pack strong food, repaired gear and fire protection; search fortresses for bell fragments to prepare for Fader.

resources.name: Ashwood
resources.tip: Clear enemies around a stand of scorched trees, then log several and store the ashwood nearby.

resources.name: Grausten
resources.tip: Mine rock formations or salvage ruins after clearing nearby enemies; use nearby storage for heavy building loads.

resources.name: Flametal Ore
resources.tip: Bring a black metal pickaxe and a safe escape plan for lava deposits; search fortress chests for extra ore.

resources.name: Charred Bone
resources.tip: Collect bones while clearing Charred patrols and structures; gather their other drops during the same run.

resources.name: Fiddlehead
resources.tip: Search Ashlands ruins for ferns and mark good patches; revisit them after the fiddleheads regrow.

resources.name: Smoke Puff
resources.tip: Mark mushrooms around rocks and ruins in the Ashlands; revisit safe patches after they regrow.

resources.name: Vineberry Cluster
resources.tip: Harvest vines on Ashlands ruins and plant seeds against a wall; revisit mature vines as berries regrow.

resources.name: Vineberry Seeds
resources.tip: Harvest vineberries for a chance at seeds; plant the seeds against a wall to grow more vines.

resources.name: Asksvin Hide
resources.tip: Hunt Asksvin or tame and feed a pair in a secure pen; collect hides and tails together.

resources.name: Asksvin Tail
resources.tip: Collect tails alongside hides from Asksvin; breeding tamed animals can provide a repeat supply.

resources.name: Morgen Sinew
resources.tip: Hunt Morgen while exploring Ashlands and check their holes; bring strong gear and space to dodge.

resources.name: Morgen Heart
resources.tip: Hunt Morgen in Ashlands and search Putrid Holes; hearts are not guaranteed from every unstarred kill.

resources.name: Volture Meat
resources.tip: Shoot Voltures from range or fight them when they land; collect meat while traveling through Ashlands.

resources.name: Bonemaw Meat
resources.tip: Hunt Bonemaws from a sturdy ship in Ashlands waters; their meat floats, so collect it before sailing away.

resources.name: Bonemaw Scale
resources.tip: Normal Bonemaws do not appear to drop scales; the wiki describes the scale as an unobtainable asset. Verify before planning a farm.

resources.name: Celestial Feather
resources.tip: Hunt Fallen Valkyries while exploring Ashlands; keep room to dodge and collect feathers after each fight.

resources.name: Sulfur
resources.tip: Mine sulfur nodes beneath Sulfur Arches and collect drops from Lava Blobs while exploring Ashlands.

resources.name: Bloodstone
resources.tip: Clear Charred Fortresses and search their chests; raid additional fortresses for more gemstones.

resources.name: Jade
resources.tip: Search Charred Fortress chests and combine gemstone runs with other fortress loot.

resources.name: Iolite
resources.tip: Search Charred Fortress chests thoroughly; visit more fortresses when you need additional gems.

categories.label: Ocean
categories.storageNote: Keep chitin and scales near equipment materials, serpent meat near cooking, and ship supplies beside the dock.
categories.expeditionNote: Carry food, a bow, repair materials and a harpoon if collecting sinking serpent drops; watch the weather and your ship's condition.

resources.name: Chitin
resources.tip: Mine barnacles on Leviathans, keeping your ship close; return aboard quickly when the creature begins to submerge.

resources.name: Serpent Meat
resources.tip: Hunt sea serpents by boat and retrieve the floating meat; search ocean routes at night or in storms.

resources.name: Serpent Scale
resources.tip: Harpoon a serpent and tow it into shallow water before killing it, since scales sink.

resources.name: Serpent Trophy
resources.tip: Tow serpents into shallow water with a harpoon before killing them; trophies sink and are not guaranteed.

categories.label: Deep North
categories.storageNote: Reserve separate storage for food, expedition supplies and new crafting materials until their uses are confirmed.
categories.expeditionNote: Bring frost protection, strong food and repaired gear; boss preparation and resource details in this guide need further verification.
categories.note: Newer 1.0 resource acquisition details not verified; consult the wiki.
